source: Existing Android DataBackupManager BOAT-AI-backup.json; never retrospective/backtest records

input.format: Primary: DataBackupManager schemaVersion=1 JSON with bets, predictions, learning, appVersion and exportedAt; prediction-only array is supported for synthetic tests
input.defaultedAuditFields: Missing combinations/stakes/odds evidence defaults to empty/null/zero, matching PredictionRecord.fromJson and counting an incomplete live BUY rather than discarding it
input.moneyUnit: JPY integers; trifectaPayout is JPY per 100 JPY ticket
input.combinationFormat: Android backup exact format N-N-N, e.g. 1-2-3; three distinct lanes 1..6
input.fieldAliases: No aliases: Android export uses stadiumNumber/raceNumber and BetRecord uses payout. venueNumber/race/actualPayout are not accepted as substitutes.
input.deduplication: Reject duplicate settled eligible value-v1 BUY race keys (date, stadiumNumber, raceNumber); never sum repeated snapshots
input.dataIntegrity: Fail closed on malformed candidate values, invalid date/race/stadium, missing mandatory keys, positive trifecta payout without a result combination, or invalid actual purchase rows
input.intentionalEvaluatorStrictness: Android JSONObject opt* may coerce some malformed legacy scalar types and createdAt=0; evaluator requires canonical scalar types, positive createdAt, appVersion/exportedAt provenance, and a learning object. Android-valid resultCombination with trifectaPayout=0 is accepted because settlement can store a known result before payout is available.

backupEnvelope.historicalBaselineMigratedThrough: Current Android export always writes a string; evaluator accepts omission for older backups but requires a string when present.
backupEnvelope.restoreDifference: Android restore does not use appVersion/exportedAt, but evaluator requires them for provenance. Android restore requires learning as an object; evaluator now matches that requirement.

actualPurchase.source: bets array only, never inferred from AI predictions
actualPurchase.settledMoney: Only settled BetRecord tickets; group tickets by date, venue and race for race counts and hits
actualPurchase.pendingStake: Separate pending stake, never include in settled ROI
actualPurchase.duplicateTicket: Reject duplicate date/venue/race/combination for an actual purchase

cohort: settled AND evaluationEligible AND recommended AND strategyId=value-v1 after applying Android PredictionRecord.fromJson defaults

audit.incompleteCandidate: Count in audit denominator but exclude all money metrics; publish failure reason counts

accounting.roiPercent: 100 * payout / stake; null if zero stake
accounting.curveOrder: date ascending, then stadiumNumber and raceNumber; within-day order is a deterministic ledger order, not actual purchase time
accounting.maxDrawdownYen: maximum previous cumulative profit peak (including initial zero) minus subsequent cumulative profit
accounting.asOf: Explicit JST date; future-dated records excluded from every period; seven and thirty days include anchor date
accounting.periodDrawdown: Rebased to zero at the start of each selected period

diagnostics.interpretation: Descriptive only. Weekday/hour are supporting diagnostics. Never treat a slice or a single high payout as proof of improvement.

requirements: no final-like odds presented as realizable live ROI
promotion.decision: No candidate may be promoted by this evaluation script; separate frozen prospective evaluation is required
